summary: Build one focused skill candidate from recurring conversation evidence and evaluate it behind explicit approval gates.

scenarios.title: Create a skill from recent work
scenarios.prompt: Use the forge-skill-from-conversations skill on these selected completed tasks and propose one reusable skill candidate.
scenarios.outcome: One evidence-backed candidate, a stop for approval, an isolated implementation, and held-out evaluation before adoption.

scenarios.title: Use supplied conversation evidence
scenarios.prompt: Use the forge-skill-from-conversations skill on this transcript. Do not scan other tasks or install anything without asking.
scenarios.outcome: A privacy-scoped skill-forging flow that preserves separate approval for the candidate and its installation.
